description:
About the company
 
 Our client is a cybersecurity company.
 
 The role
 
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Own technical delivery and communication for important customers, spending roughly 60% of your time coding and 40% in direct customer work.
 
 What you'll do
 
 - Triage customer questions, bug reports, and feature requests.
 
 - Ship fixes and incremental improvements into production.
 
 - Develop deep product and backend knowledge to guide customer decisions.
 
 - Run discovery on customer needs and return improvements to the core product.
 
 - Support technical demonstrations, customer engagements, and industry events.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 
 - 2 to 5 years of relevant full-stack engineering experience.
 
 - Experience building a product from an early stage.
 
 - Ability to write and ship production code and make improvements from customer feedback.
 
 - A computer science or closely related technical degree.
 
 - Proficiency with TypeScript, React, or Python.
 
 - Strong customer communication and independent ownership of ambiguous work.
 
 Bonus points
 
 - Previous forward deployed engineering experience.
 
 - Demonstrable software delivery alongside a consulting background.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 
 - Base salary: USD 170,000 to 250,000 per year.
 
 - Equity: 0.08-0.2%.
 
 - Health, dental, and vision coverage.
 
 - 401(k), commuting support, and office lunch and dinner.
 
 - Relocation support.
 
 Location and work model
 
 - Five days per week onsite in San Francisco, with up to 25% travel. The role expects fast customer responses from 7 AM to 7 PM Pacific time and prompt acknowledgment of urgent requests outside those hours.
